claim: Live agreement between Earth Engine and unmodified PyTorch for one trained SMP model prepared with tensor_ee.smp.adapt_smp_model; not model accuracy, not other chips, encoders or architectures.

model.architecture: segmentation_models_pytorch Unet, encoder resnet18 (the SegWater recipe)

adapter.probe: nonconstant dyadic arange modulo 251, divided by 128

weights: the public SegWater weight tables in data/manifests/segwater_r18_weight_manifest.json, read through MatchedWeightProvider

input.description: two synthetic float32 bands computed in Earth Engine from integer pixel coordinates; the same values built locally for PyTorch

execution.mode: one batch export of logits, input echoes, pixel coordinates and validity to an image asset, then one computePixels of that 64 x 64 asset
execution.earlier_attempt: the same graph as one interactive computePixels was refused with 'User memory limit exceeded'; no result
